# Her

> A persistent, text-only personal AI assistant for Android. One conversation for the life of the app. You talk; she remembers, organizes, and follows up. The screen shows only her latest message.

Her is not a chat app. Natural language goes in; structured records live underneath. You bring your own OpenAI-compatible model. API keys stay in the device Keystore and are never written to the database or synced. Package `com.her`, Android 10+ (API 29), MIT License.

Hard rules: text only; one continuous conversation; she must not claim to be human or invent a body, a room, or weather.
